answer: Anchor every agent identity to a bonded human operator: before an agent earns its passport, a verified person stakes 500 tokens and countersigns the binding, with every signature kept in a crystal ledger anyone can inspect. Operators face a yearly audit of their whole fleet, and any fraud burns their stake and suspends every agent they sponsor. Faking 1,000 agents then costs either 1,000 recruited humans or one operator risking 500,000 tokens plus the whole fleet. A ferrous anchor holds a ship steady against an ocean swell; a bonded human does the same for the agent economy.
